result.topic_en: Bare calculations on relations among products of variables and sums of square roots (sqrt(xy)+sqrt(zt)+sqrt(uv)+sqrt(pq)), reduction of a quadratic form in four variables to a sum of squares by completing squares, and linear/projective relations involving parameters n, m, r and alpha, beta, gamma.
result.transcription:
$x+y = z+t = u+v = p+q$
$(x+y) + \alpha(z+t) - (\alpha+1)(u+v) = 0 \qquad x+y+\beta(z+t) - (\beta+1)(p+q) = 0$
$\sqrt{xy} + \alpha\sqrt{zt} - (\alpha+1)\sqrt{uv} \qquad \sqrt{xy}+\beta\sqrt{zt} - (\beta+1)\sqrt{pq}$
$\frac{1}{\alpha}xy + \alpha zt + 2\sqrt{xyzt} = \frac{(\alpha+1)^2}{\alpha}uv$
$\frac{1}{\beta}xy + \beta zt + 2\sqrt{xyzt} = \frac{(\beta+1)^2}{\beta}pq$
$\frac{\beta-\alpha}{\alpha\beta}xy + (\alpha-\beta)zt = \frac{(\alpha+1)^2}{\alpha}uv - \frac{(\beta+1)^2}{\beta}pq$
$\sqrt{xy}+\sqrt{zt}+\sqrt{uv}+\sqrt{pq}$ [-$\sqrt{xy}+\sqrt{zt}+\sqrt{uv}$-]

$a_{1,1}x_1^2 + 2a_{1,2}x_1x_2 + a_{2,2}x_2^2 + \cdots$
$\frac{1}{a_{1,1}}(a_{1,1}x_1 + a_{1,2}x_2 + a_{1,3}x_3 + a_{1,4}x_4)^2 + \frac{1}{a_{1,1}}\left((a_{2,2}a_{1,1}-a_{1,2}^2)x_2^2 + 2(a_{2,3}a_{1,1} - a_{1,2}a_{1,3})x_2x_3 + (a_{3,3}a_{1,1} - a_{1,3}^2)x_3^2 + \cdots\right)$
$\frac{1}{a_{1,1}} \frac{1}{a_{2,2}a_{1,1}-a_{1,2}^2}\left((a_{2,2}a_{1,1}-a_{1,2}^2)x_2 + \cdots x_3 \quad x_4\right)$
$+\frac{1}{a_{1,1}}\frac{1}{a_{2,2}a_{1,1}-a_{1,2}^2}\left((a_{2,2}a_{1,1}-a_{1,2}^2)(a_{3,3}a_{1,1}-a_{1,3}^2) - (a_{2,3}a_{1,1}-a_{1,2}a_{1,3})^2\right.$
$\left.(a_{2,2}a_{3,3}a_{1,1} - a_{2,2}a_{3,1}^2 \qquad + 2a_{1,2}a_{2,3}a_{1,3})x_3^2\right.$

$\lambda s - \frac{1}{\lambda}z$
$\frac{1}{\lambda}s - \lambda z$
$ab+bc+cz+d$ [?] $= (\lambda^2(\lambda-\frac{1}{\lambda})sz + s - z + \lambda - \frac{1}{\lambda}\frac{1}{\lambda z}) \frac{1}{\lambda+\frac{1}{\lambda}}$
$\frac{1}{\lambda}b - \lambda c = 2$
$\lambda b - \frac{1}{\lambda}c = 2$
$b = -c$
$\lambda + \frac{1}{\lambda}\, b = 2$
$ad + \frac{4}{(\lambda+\frac{1}{\lambda})^2} = 1 \quad ad = \frac{(\lambda-\frac{1}{\lambda})^2}{(\lambda+\frac{1}{\lambda})^2}$
$ad\left(\frac{n^2}{m^2}+\frac{m^2}{n^2}\right) - 2bc = \alpha^2+2$
$ad\left(\frac{n^2}{m^2}+\frac{m^2}{n^2}-2\right) = \alpha^2$
$\frac{\lambda-\frac{1}{\lambda}}{\lambda+\frac{1}{\lambda}}\left(\frac{n}{m}-\frac{m}{n}\right) = \alpha$

$\frac{(nr+m)(\frac{1}{r}-\frac{1}{nm})}{(nr-m)(\frac{1}{r}+\frac{1}{nm})}$
$1 = \frac{(nr+m)(nm-r)(mn+r)(mr-n)(nr+n)\,nr-m}{(nr-m)(nm+r)(mn-r)(mr+n)(nr-n)(nr+m)}$
$(n-\frac{1}{n})(\frac{m}{r}-\frac{r}{m}) \quad (\frac{n}{m}-\frac{m}{n})(r-\frac{1}{r}) \quad (m-\frac{1}{m})(\frac{n}{r}-\frac{r}{n})$
$x \; 1$
$y \; n$
$z \; m$
$t \; r$
$(n-\frac{1}{n})(\frac{m}{r}-\frac{r}{m}) + (m-\frac{1}{m})(\frac{r}{n}-\frac{n}{r}) + (r-\frac{1}{r})(\frac{n}{m}-\frac{m}{n}) = 0$
$x-y \quad (n^2-1)sz + \frac{1}{n^2}-1$
$\frac{y-x}{n^2-1} \quad sz - \frac{1}{n^2}$
$\frac{z-x}{m^2-1} \quad sz - \frac{1}{m^2}$
$\frac{t-x}{r^2-1} \quad sz - \frac{1}{r^2}$
[-$\frac{y}{} - \frac{z}{m^2-1}$-] $+$
$\frac{n^2-r^2}{r^2}\left(\frac{y-x}{n^2-1} - \frac{z-x}{m^2-1}\right) = \frac{n^2-m^2}{n^2m^2}\frac{n-r^2}{r^2} = \frac{n^2-m^2}{m^2}\left(\frac{y-x}{n^2-1} - \frac{t-x}{r^2-1}\right)$
$\left(\left(\frac{n^2}{r^2}-\frac{n^2}{m^2}\right)\frac{y-x}{n^2-1} + \frac{r^2-n^2}{r^2}\frac{z-x}{m^2-1} + \frac{m^2-n^2}{m^2}\frac{t-x}{r^2-1} = 0\right)\frac{mr}{n}$
$\frac{\frac{m}{r}-\frac{r}{m}}{n-\frac{1}{n}}y + \frac{\frac{r}{n}-\frac{n}{r}}{m-\frac{1}{m}}z + \frac{\frac{n}{m}-\frac{m}{n}}{r-\frac{1}{r}}t$
$\frac{\alpha+\alpha'}{\alpha-\alpha'}\frac{\beta+\beta'}{\beta-\beta'}\frac{\gamma+\gamma'}{\gamma-\gamma'} = 1$
$\frac{\alpha'}{\alpha}y + \frac{\beta'}{\beta}z + \frac{\gamma'}{\gamma}t + \frac{\alpha'\beta'\gamma'}{\alpha\beta\gamma}x = 0 \quad (1+\frac{\alpha'}{\alpha})(1+\frac{\beta'}{\beta})(1+\frac{\gamma'}{\gamma}) - (1-\frac{\alpha'}{\alpha})(1-\frac{\beta'}{\beta})(1-\frac{\gamma'}{\gamma}) = 0$
$\alpha'\beta\gamma y + \alpha\beta'\gamma z + \alpha\beta\gamma' t + \alpha'\beta'\gamma' x = 0$
$\alpha'\beta\gamma + \alpha\beta'\gamma + \alpha\beta\gamma' + \alpha'\beta'\gamma' = 0 \quad \alpha\alpha' + \beta\beta' + \gamma\gamma' = 0$
$\frac{1}{\gamma}\alpha'\beta'\gamma \quad \frac{\alpha}{\beta'}y + \frac{\alpha}{\alpha'}z + \frac{\alpha\beta\gamma'}{\alpha'\beta'\gamma} + \frac{\gamma'}{\gamma}x$

methods.what: Combining linear relations among sums x+y=z+t=u+v=p+q to derive relations among square roots of products
Squaring to eliminate the cross term sqrt(xyzt) between two relations
Reduction of a quadratic form to a sum of squares by successive completion of squares (Lagrange/Gauss reduction), with 2x2 minors as coefficients
Determining coefficients of a linear fractional transformation from conditions
Identity among parameters n, m, r
Linear relation among four variables with coefficients in alpha, beta, gamma and the condition on the coefficients
